description: This file defines the Task model class within the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing task records in the database, including adding tasks and retrieving task counts.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A model class extending Opencart's base Model class, providing functionalities to add tasks and retrieve task totals.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Inserts a new task record into the database with provided data and returns the ID of the newly inserted task.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of task records in the database, with optional filtering by code and status.
